title: Job Fair - 3
summary: A Job Fair was conducted on 29 September 2026 at TSEC, Bandra-West, with Rotary Club of Bombay Airport as the host in association with Vedanta Foundation.
description: A Job Fair was conducted on 29 September 2026 at TSEC, Bandra-West, with Rotary Club of Bombay Airport as the host in association with Vedanta Foundation. The Job Fair was part of the Government of Maharashtra’s Rojgar Mahakumbh initiative. The event received 240 registrations, with 12 companies participating in the interview process. The project was attended by PP Rajesh, Rtn Swati Agarwal, PP Sitaramji and Rtn Anjali from RCBA. The initiative was spearheaded by PP Rajesh Agarwal from RCBA and Dr Anjali Malviya from TSEC.
